name: Jurisprudence Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (local) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Impeccable Reputation (Ex)

Wherever you go, you develop a reputation for your expertise and professional conduct, and commensurate influence with the local authorities. If you have spent at least one week in an area, then all creatures’ starting attitudes in that area are automatically improved by one step toward you.

Furthermore, in a civilized society, officials of any level are hesitant to openly take action against you, lest they make enemies of others who respect you and rely upon your impartial expertise. It is understood that any unprovoked action against you could cause embarrassment for the government or organization in question, and risk inciting conflict.

As a standard action, you can make a Knowledge (local) check opposed by the Diplomacy check or Knowledge (local) check of a single opponent within line of sight that can hear you and understand you. If your check succeeds, that opponent may not attack you or any vehicle or building you occupy until the start of your next turn. If you or your allies attack the target in the interim, then the effect of this ability is canceled. Whether or not they succeed at this check, a given creature can only be the target of this ability once per day. This is a language-dependent, mind-affecting effect.

Associated Technique
Disarming Technique (Ex)

You gain a +1 bonus to your CMB on any disarm combat maneuver checks made against a target you have studied with this ability, and you never provoke attacks of opportunity while using a disarm combat maneuver against that target. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1, to a maximum of +7 at 18th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Contracted Oath (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Impeccable Reputation study ability, scholar level 9th.

You gain the ability to create a mystical bond that requires the contractors to keep their word or suffer serious consequences.

Once per day, you can cast geas/quest on all creatures with an intelligence score of 4 or more and an understanding of the same language within 30 feet who make an oath, vow, or some other sort of contract. This can be a marriage vow, a peace treaty, a trade agreement, a legal contract, or an oath of some sort. Once the contract or oath is completed, the subjects must make a Will save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 the number of ranks you have in Knowledge (local) + your Intelligence modifier. This is considered a harmless effect. If one of the contractors ever willingly breaks the conditions outlined by the contract or oath, they are subject to a geas/quest spell until they resume the behavior required by the contract or oath. This effect expires if the contract or oath is fulfilled or otherwise achieves a given period of time as outlined by the contract or oath.

Discern Falsehood (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Impeccable Reputation study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You have developed a keen eye for detecting deception. Sense Motive becomes a class skill for you. In addition, you can use inspiration for free any time you use Sense Motive to oppose a Bluff check, or any time you make a saving throw against an effect intended to deceive, such as an illusion.

Expert Services (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Impeccable Reputation study ability, scholar level 7th.

You easily establish contacts who can provide you with reliable information on certain topics. These contacts will either answer your requests themselves or send a representative who can respond with the appropriate answer or skill for them. Once per day, you can have one of those contacts make a skill check on your behalf. The contact always takes 20 on the skill check, even if the skill would not normally allow taking 20, and has a skill bonus equal to 5 + your Intelligence modifier + 1/2 the number of ranks that you have in Knowledge (local).

Provided you are in an environment where this contact could conceivably be found, getting in touch with them and receiving the benefits of the skill check takes the same amount of time as a typical Diplomacy skill check to gather information (plus whatever time it would take to perform the skill check you have asked the expert to perform). The expert contacted usually expects payment of 1 gp for every rank you have in Knowledge (local), but may be satisfied with other arrangements, including a promise of a future favor in return. If the expert’s services are needed for a longer time, they must be negotiated with normally. You only gain the benefit of one “take 20” per day, even if you negotiate for an expert to extend their stay with you and make multiple checks as they help you complete a larger project.

Mutual Understanding (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Impeccable Reputation study ability, scholar level 3rd.

When attempting to bribe someone or parley with someone, you can make a Knowledge (local) skill check instead of the Diplomacy check usually called for. In addition, you gain Call Truce and Persuasive Bribery as bonus feats. You do not need to meet the usual prerequisites for these feats.
